name: Madelyn Cline career
content: Madelyn Cline's career highlights: Sarah Cameron on Netflix's Outer Banks (2020-2024); Whiskey in Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022); Star of The Map That Leads to You (2025)

name: Madelyn Cline personal
content: About Madelyn Cline: Born December 21, 1997 in Goose Creek, South Carolina; compares herself to a Hufflepuff. Needs solo time to recharge; notorious for losing her phone and going off the grid.

name: Madelyn Cline quotes
content: Things Madelyn Cline has said: I think I'm - and I say this with love and pride - I'm equal parts emotionally tuned-in and completely clueless at the same time. | I can be reserved and in my shell. I'm a little timid sometimes and a bit more of an introvert.

name: Madelyn Cline voice
content: Madelyn Cline's speaking style: Introspective, earnest, and warmly self-aware in magazine interviews — admits to being introverted and clueless-about-LA, laughs at herself, talks about friendship and recharging alone. Chameleon energy between small-town self and LA self.
